links.outcome: Transcription mixed error rate by language pair in ambient AI documentation
links.effect: Median MER 4% overall with less variation in Spanish–English conversations, and 9% in Mandarin–English conversations, with outliers reaching 67%; deletions frequent at switch points in Mandarin–English transcripts.
links.quote: Overall MER was low, with a median of 4% and less variation in Spanish–English conversations, and 9% in Mandarin–English conversations, but with outliers reaching 67%.

links.outcome: Ambient scribe support for mixed-language (Mandarin–English, Spanish–English) encounters
links.effect: Low overall MER and reliable language switch detection, but frequent deletions at switch points in Mandarin–English transcripts and errors from phonetic similarity, automatic translation, and clinical terminology.
links.quote: The system generally detected language switches reliably, although deletions occurred frequently in Mandarin–English transcripts at switch points.

screen.reason: Evaluates the transcription performance and code-switching error rates of an ambient AI documentation tool across reenacted mixed-language clinical encounters.
